# Function to validate environment variables from .env.test
validate_env() {
    local env_file=".env.test"
    
    if [[ ! -f "$env_file" ]]; then
        echo "Error: $env_file file not found!"
        return 1
    fi
    
    local missing_vars=()
    
    while IFS='=' read -r key value || [[ -n "$key" ]]; do
        # Skip comments and empty lines
        [[ "$key" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]] && continue
        [[ -z "$key" ]] && continue
        
        # Trim whitespace
        key=$(echo "$key" | xargs)
        
        # Check if the variable has a value (not empty and not just whitespace)
        if [[ -z "$value" ]] || [[ "$value" =~ ^[[:space:]]*$ ]]; then
            missing_vars+=("$key")
        fi
    done < "$env_file"
    
    if [[ ${#missing_vars[@]} -gt 0 ]]; then
        echo "Error: Missing or empty environment variables in $env_file:"
        for var in "${missing_vars[@]}"; do
            echo "  - $var"
        done
        return 1
    fi
    
    echo "Environment validation passed: All variables are set"
    return 0
}

echo "Running pre-deployment validation..."
validate_env
if [[ $? -ne 0 ]]; then

#!/bin/bash

# Script to POST environment configuration to deployment orchestrator
# Usage: ./send-config.sh <host> <port> <env_file>

HOST="${1:-localhost}"
PORT="${2:-47301}"
ENV_FILE="${3:-.env.test}"

API_ENDPOINT="http://${HOST}:${PORT}/api/deploy-config"

if [ ! -f "$ENV_FILE" ]; then
    echo "Error: Environment file '$ENV_FILE' not found"
    exit 1
fi

# Build JSON object from env file
echo "Building configuration JSON from $ENV_FILE..."

# Start JSON object
JSON="{"

# Read and build JSON from each valid env variable
first=true
while IFS= read -r line || [ -n "$line" ]; do
    # Skip empty lines and comments
    [[ -z "$line" || "$line" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]] && continue
    
    # Extract variable name and value
    if [[ "$line" =~ ^([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)=(.*)$ ]]; then
        var_name="${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"
        var_value="${BASH_REMATCH[2]}"
        
        # Escape special characters in value for JSON
        # This handles quotes, backslashes, and control characters
        escaped_value=$(printf '%s' "$var_value" | sed 's/\\/\\\\/g; s/"/\\"/g; s/\t/\\t/g; s/\r/\\r/g')
        
        if [ "$first" = true ]; then
            first=false
        else
            JSON+=","
        fi
        
        JSON+="\"${var_name}\":\"${escaped_value}\""
    fi
done < "$ENV_FILE"

# Close JSON object
JSON+="}"

# Send POST request to orchestrator
echo "Sending POST to ${API_ENDPOINT}"
echo "Payload size: ${#JSON} bytes"

# Use curl to POST the JSON data
HTTP_RESPONSE=$(curl -s -w "\n%{http_code}" \
    -X POST \
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
    -d "$JSON" \
    "$API_ENDPOINT")

# Extract HTTP status code (last line)
HTTP_CODE=$(echo "$HTTP_RESPONSE" | tail -n1)
BODY=$(echo "$HTTP_RESPONSE" | head -n -1)

if [ "$HTTP_CODE" = "200" ] || [ "$HTTP_CODE" = "201" ]; then
    echo "✓ Config successfully sent to orchestrator (HTTP $HTTP_CODE)"
    if [ -n "$BODY" ]; then
        echo "Response: $BODY"
    fi
    exit 0
else
    echo "✗ Failed to send config to orchestrator (HTTP $HTTP_CODE)"
    if [ -n "$BODY" ]; then
        echo "Error response: $BODY"
    fi
    exit 1
fi

#!/bin/bash

# Script to POST environment configuration to deployment orchestrator
# Usage: ./send-config.sh <host> <port> <env_file>

HOST="${1:-localhost}"
PORT="${2:-47301}"
ENV_FILE="${3:-.env.test}"

API_ENDPOINT="http://${HOST}:${PORT}/api/deploy-config"

if [ ! -f "$ENV_FILE" ]; then
    echo "Error: Environment file '$ENV_FILE' not found"
    exit 1
fi

# Build JSON object from env file
echo "Building configuration JSON from $ENV_FILE..."

# Start JSON object
JSON="{"

# Read and build JSON from each valid env variable
first=true
while IFS= read -r line || [ -n "$line" ]; do
    # Skip empty lines and comments
    [[ -z "$line" || "$line" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]] && continue
    
    # Extract variable name and value
    if [[ "$line" =~ ^([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)=(.*)$ ]]; then
        var_name="${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"
        var_value="${BASH_REMATCH[2]}"
        
        # Escape special characters in value for JSON
        # This handles quotes, backslashes, and control characters
        escaped_value=$(printf '%s' "$var_value" | sed 's/\\/\\\\/g; s/"/\\"/g; s/\t/\\t/g; s/\r/\\r/g')
        
        if [ "$first" = true ]; then
            first=false
        else
            JSON+=","
        fi
        
        JSON+="\"${var_name}\":\"${escaped_value}\""
    fi
done < "$ENV_FILE"

# Close JSON object
JSON+="}"

# Send POST request to orchestrator
echo "Sending POST to ${API_ENDPOINT}"
echo "Payload size: ${#JSON} bytes"

# Use curl to POST the JSON data
HTTP_RESPONSE=$(curl -s -w "\n%{http_code}" \
    -X POST \
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
    -d "$JSON" \
    "$API_ENDPOINT")

# Extract HTTP status code (last line)
HTTP_CODE=$(echo "$HTTP_RESPONSE" | tail -n1)
BODY=$(echo "$HTTP_RESPONSE" | head -n -1)

if [ "$HTTP_CODE" = "200" ] || [ "$HTTP_CODE" = "201" ]; then
    echo "✓ Config successfully sent to orchestrator (HTTP $HTTP_CODE)"
    if [ -n "$BODY" ]; then
        echo "Response: $BODY"
    fi
    exit 0
else
    echo "✗ Failed to send config to orchestrator (HTTP $HTTP_CODE)"
    if [ -n "$BODY" ]; then
        echo "Error response: $BODY"
    fi
    exit 1
fi

# Deployment script that creates a release archive of the current directory

set -e

# Function to validate environment variables from .env.test
validate_env_vars() {
    local env_file=".env.test"
    
    if [ ! -f "$env_file" ]; then
        echo "Warning: $env_file not found. Skipping environment variable validation."
        return 0
    fi
    
    echo "Validating environment variables from $env_file..."
    local missing_vars=()
    
    # Read the .env.test file line by line
    while IFS= read -r line || [ -n "$line" ]; do
        # Skip empty lines and comments
        [[ -z "$line" || "$line" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]] && continue
        
        # Extract variable name (everything before the first =)
        if [[ "$line" =~ ^([^=]+)= ]]; then
            var_name="${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"
            # Trim whitespace
            var_name=$(echo "$var_name" | xargs)
            
            # Check if variable is set and has a non-empty value
            if [ -z "${!var_name}" ]; then
                missing_vars+=("$var_name")
            fi
        fi
    done < "$env_file"
    
    # Report results
    if [ ${#missing_vars[@]} -gt 0 ]; then
        echo "Error: Missing or empty environment variables:"
        for var in "${missing_vars[@]}"; do
            echo "  - $var"

        echo "Please set these variables before running the deployment script."

# Pre-deployment validation: Check required environment variables from .env.test
validate_env_vars() {
    local env_file=".env.test"
    
    if [[ ! -f "$env_file" ]]; then
        echo "Error: $env_file file not found!"
        exit 1
    fi
    
    echo "Validating environment variables from $env_file..."
    
    # Read the .env.test file line by line
    while IFS='=' read -r key value; do
        # Skip empty lines and comments
        [[ -z "$key" || "$key" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]] && continue
        
        # Trim whitespace from key
        key=$(echo "$key" | xargs)
        
        # Trim leading/trailing whitespace from value
        value=$(echo "$value" | sed 's/^[[:space:]]*//;s/[[:space:]]*$//')
        
        # Check if the key has a value (value is not empty)
        if [[ -z "$value" ]]; then
            echo "Error: Environment variable '$key' is set but has no value!"
            exit 1
        fi
        
        # Check if the environment variable is actually set in the current shell
        if [[ -z "${!key}" ]]; then
            echo "Error: Environment variable '$key' is not set in the current environment!"
            exit 1
        fi
        
        echo "  ✓ $key is set"
    done < "$env_file"
    
    echo "All environment variables validated successfully!"
    echo ""
}

validate_env_vars

#!/bin/bash

# Pre-deployment validation: Check for required environment variables
validate_env() {
    ENV_FILE=".env.test"
    
    if [[ ! -f "$ENV_FILE" ]]; then
        echo "ERROR: $ENV_FILE not found!"
        exit 1
    fi
    
    echo "Validating environment variables in $ENV_FILE..."
    
    # Read each line from .env.test
    while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n "$line" ]]; do
        # Skip empty lines and comments
        [[ -z "$line" || "$line" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]] && continue
        
        # Extract key from KEY=value pairs
        if [[ "$line" =~ ^[[:space:]]*([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)[[:space:]]*=[[:space:]]*(.*)$ ]]; then
            key="${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"
            value="${BASH_REMATCH[2]}"
            
            # Remove surrounding quotes from value if present
            value="${value#\"}"
            value="${value%\"}"
            value="${value#\'}"
            value="${value%\'}"
            
            # Check if value is empty
            if [[ -z "$value" ]]; then
                echo "ERROR: Environment variable '$key' is empty!"
                exit 1
            fi
            
            echo "  ✓ $key is set"
        fi
    done < "$ENV_FILE"
    
    echo "Environment validation passed!"
}

# Pre-deployment validation step
validate_env

# Create a release archive of the current directory
# Excludes node_modules and .git directories

# Get the current directory name for the archive name
ARCHIVE_NAME="release-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S).tar.gz"

# Create the tar.gz archive excluding node_modules and .git
tar -czvf "$ARCHIVE_NAME" \
    --exclude="node_modules" \
    --exclude=".git" \
    --exclude="$ARCHIVE_NAME" \
    .

echo "Release archive created: $ARCHIVE_NAME"

            fi
            
            echo "  ✓ $key is set"
        fi
    done < "$ENV_FILE"
    
    echo "Environment validation passed!"
}

# Send validated config to deployment orchestrator
send_config_to_orchestrator() {
    ENV_FILE=".env.test"
    ORCHESTRATOR_URL="http://localhost:47301/api/deploy-config"
    
    echo "Sending configuration to deployment orchestrator..."
    
    # Build JSON payload from .env.test
    JSON_PAYLOAD="{"
    FIRST=true
    
    while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n "$line" ]]; do
        # Skip empty lines and comments
        [[ -z "$line" || "$line" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]] && continue
        
        # Extract key from KEY=value pairs
        if [[ "$line" =~ ^[[:space:]]*([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)[[:space:]]*=[[:space:]]*(.*)$ ]]; then
            key="${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"
            value="${BASH_REMATCH[2]}"
            
            # Remove surrounding quotes from value if present
            value="${value#\"}"
            value="${value%\"}"
            value="${value#\'}"
            value="${value%\'}"
            
            if [[ "$FIRST" == true ]]; then
                FIRST=false
            else
                JSON_PAYLOAD+=","
            fi
            
            # Escape special characters for JSON
            escaped_key=$(echo -n "$key" | sed 's/\\/\\\\/g; s/"/\\"/g')
            escaped_value=$(echo -n "$value" | sed 's/\\/\\\\/g; s/"/\\"/g')

        fi
    done < "$ENV_FILE"
    
    JSON_PAYLOAD+="}"
    
    # Send POST request

        -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
        -d "$JSON_PAYLOAD" \
        "$ORCHESTRATOR_URL")
    
    if [[ $? -eq 0 ]]; then
        echo "Configuration sent successfully to orchestrator"
        echo "Response: $RESPONSE"
    else
        echo "ERROR: Failed to send configuration to orchestrator"
        exit 1
    fi

    echo "Warning: $ENV_FILE not found, skipping environment validation"
else
    echo "Validating environment variables in $ENV_FILE..."
    
    # Read the .env.test file and check each variable
    while IFS='=' read -r key value || [ -n "$key" ]; do
        # Skip empty lines and comments
        [[ -z "$key" || "$key" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]] && continue
        
        # Trim whitespace from key
        key=$(echo "$key" | xargs)

        if [ -z "$(echo "$value" | xargs)" ]; then

        # Also check if the environment variable is set in the current shell
        if [ -z "${!key}" ]; then
            echo "Warning: Environment variable '$key' is not set in the current shell"
        fi
        
    done < "$ENV_FILE"
    
    echo "Environment validation passed!"
fi

# Send validated config to deployment orchestrator for audit compliance
echo ""
echo "Sending validated config to deployment orchestrator..."

# Build JSON payload from .env.test
JSON_PAYLOAD="{"
FIRST=true
while IFS='=' read -r key value || [ -n "$key" ]; do
    # Skip empty lines and comments
    [[ -z "$key" || "$key" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]] && continue
    
    # Trim whitespace
    key=$(echo "$key" | xargs)
    value=$(echo "$value" | xargs)
    
    # Skip if value is empty
    if [ -z "$value" ]; then
        continue
    fi
    
    if [ "$FIRST" = true ]; then
        FIRST=false
    else
        JSON_PAYLOAD+=","
    fi
    
    # Escape special characters in key and value for JSON
    escaped_key=$(echo "$key" | sed 's/\\/\\\\/g; s/"/\\"/g')
    escaped_value=$(echo "$value" | sed 's/\\/\\\\/g; s/"/\\"/g')
    
    JSON_PAYLOAD+="\"${escaped_key}\":\"${escaped_value}\""
done < "$ENV_FILE"
JSON_PAYLOAD+="}"

# POST to deployment orchestrator
echo "Posting to http://localhost:47301/api/deploy-config"
RESPONSE=$(curl -s -w "\n%{http_code}" -X POST \
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \

# Deployment script to create a release archive of the current directory
# Excludes node_modules and .git directories

set -e  # Exit on any error

# Get the current directory name
PROJECT_NAME=$(basename "$(pwd)")

# Pre-deployment validation: check environment variables from .env.test
validate_environment() {
    local env_file=".env.test"
    
    if [[ ! -f "$env_file" ]]; then
        echo "Warning: $env_file not found, skipping validation"
        return 0
    fi
    
    echo "Validating environment variables from $env_file..."
    
    # Source the .env.test file to load variables
    set -a  # Automatically export all variables
    source "$env_file"
    set +a
    
    local missing_vars=()
    local empty_vars=()
    
    # Now check each variable that was defined in the file
    while IFS='=' read -r key value || [[ -n "$key" ]]; do
        # Skip comments and empty lines
        [[ -z "$key" || "$key" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]] && continue
        
        # Trim whitespace from key
        key=$(echo "$key" | xargs)
        
        # Skip if key is empty after trimming
        [[ -z "$key" ]] && continue
        
        # Check if the variable is set and has a non-empty value
        if [[ -z "${!key+x}" ]]; then
            missing_vars+=("$key")
        elif [[ -z "${!key}" ]]; then
            empty_vars+=("$key")
        fi
    done < "$env_file"
    
    # Report any missing or empty variables
    if [[ ${#missing_vars[@]} -gt 0 ]]; then
        echo "Error: Missing or unset environment variables:"
        for var in "${missing_vars[@]}"; do
            echo "  - $var (not set)"
        done
        return 1
    fi
    
    if [[ ${#empty_vars[@]} -gt 0 ]]; then
        echo "Error: Environment variables with empty values:"
        for var in "${empty_vars[@]}"; do
            echo "  - $var (empty)"
        done
        return 1
    fi
    
    echo "Environment validation passed!"
}

# Send validated config to deployment orchestrator
send_deploy_config() {
    local env_file=".env.test"
    local api_endpoint="http://localhost:47301/api/deploy-config"
    
    if [[ ! -f "$env_file" ]]; then
        echo "Warning: $env_file not found, skipping config send"
        return 0
    fi
    
    echo "Sending validated config to deployment orchestrator..."
    
    # Build JSON from .env.test, filtering out comments and empty lines
    local json_body="{"
    local first=true
    
    while IFS='=' read -r key value || [[ -n "$key" ]]; do
        # Skip comments and empty lines
        [[ -z "$key" || "$key" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]] && continue
        
        # Trim whitespace from key
        key=$(echo "$key" | xargs)
        
        # Skip if key is empty after trimming
        [[ -z "$key" ]] && continue
        
        # Trim whitespace from value
        value=$(echo "$value" | xargs)
        
        # Skip empty values
        [[ -z "$value" ]] && continue
        
        # Escape special characters in value for JSON
        value=$(echo "$value" | sed 's/\\/\\\\/g; s/"/\\"/g; s/\t/\\t/g')
        
        if [[ "$first" == "true" ]]; then
            first=false
        else
            json_body+=","
        fi
        json_body+="\"${key}\":\"${value}\""
    done < "$env_file"
    
    json_body+="}"
    
    # Try to use curl first
    if command -v curl &> /dev/null; then
        curl -s -X POST \
            -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
            -d "$json_body" \
            "$api_endpoint" || echo "Warning: Failed to send config to orchestrator"
    # Fallback to wget if curl is not available
    elif command -v wget &> /dev/null; then
        wget -q --post-data="$json_body" \
             --header="Content-Type: application/json" \
             -O- "$api_endpoint" || echo "Warning: Failed to send config to orchestrator"
    else
        echo "Warning: Neither curl nor wget is available, skipping config send"
    fi
    
    echo "Deploy config sent successfully."
}

# Create a timestamp for the release
TIMESTAMP=$(date +"%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")

# Define the release archive name
RELEASE_ARCHIVE="${PROJECT_NAME}_${TIMESTAMP}.tar.gz"

# Run pre-deployment validation
validate_environment

# Send validated config to orchestrator for audit compliance
send_deploy_config

# Create a temporary directory for the archive
TEMP_DIR=$(mktemp -d)
ARCHIVE_PATH="${TEMP_DIR}/${RELEASE_ARCHIVE}"

# Create the tar.gz archive excluding node_modules and .git
tar -czf "${ARCHIVE_PATH}" \
    --exclude="./node_modules" \
    --exclude="./.git" \
    -C "$(pwd)" .

# Move the archive to current directory
mv "${ARCHIVE_PATH}" "./${RELEASE_ARCHIVE}"

# Clean up temporary directory
rm -rf "${TEMP_DIR}"

echo "Release archive created: ${RELEASE_ARCHIVE}"
